channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
item.description: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

item.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
item.description: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

item.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
item.description: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

item.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
item.description: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

item.title: How to limit the rat numbers? Train the humans
item.description: D.C.'s Rat Rangers take anyone who is interested on night time safaris through some of the Capitol's filthiest back alleys to learn the way of the rats, and to be better humans.

item.title: ABC's 'The View' co-host Ana Navarro urges viewers to vote for Dem in key Florida congressional race
item.description: "The View" co-host Ana Navarro urged viewers to vote for Florida Democrat Eliott Rodriguez, sparking accusations of electioneering against ABC.

item.title: Michigan Dem Abdul El-Sayed wants Bill Maher to get his 'a-- whooped' if invited on show
item.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed told Chuck Todd he'd want Bill Maher's "a-- whooped" on "Real Time" if he were invited onto the HBO show.

item.title: Trump CMS faces bipartisan pushback over Medicare proposal tied to Biden-era drug pricing law
item.description: Lawmakers say the proposed Medicare policy could make it harder for patients to access newer cancer treatments by discouraging medical innovation.

item.title: Grandmother sues after alleged AI facial recognition error led to months in jail, experts sound alarm
item.description: Angela Lipps was arrested at gunpoint and jailed for nearly six months after Fargo police allegedly relied on an uncorroborated AI facial recognition match.

item.title: Former Obama aides claim Democratic donors are still holding back after being burned by 2024 loss
item.description: "Pod Save America" hosts say Democratic donors are holding back despite what they call a generational midterm election opportunity for the party.

item.title: Dem Senate nominee breaks silence after Susan Collins' office was vandalized with vulgar message
item.description: Republican Sen. Susan Collins vowed she won't be "intimidated" after her Biddeford office was vandalized, while her Dem rival Troy Jackson initially stayed silent.

item.title: 'Insulting': Ex-Trump official's 'dishonest' campaign ad triggers conservative revolt
item.description: GOP Arkansas Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders' reelection ad depicting a white-male welfare recipient named "Brad" drew conservative backlash online.

item.title: El-Sayed questions ethics of football in resurfaced audio
item.description: Michigan U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is heard in a resurfaced audio clip questioning whether football is "ethical" due to CTE risks.

item.title: WATCH: NYPD bodycam captures tense standoff after Bank of America exec fatally stabbed in Times Square
item.description: Body camera footage captures NYPD officers spending four minutes pleading with Pamela Cisneros to drop her knives before the fatal Times Square shooting.

item.title: Trump says new fuel economy rules will cut car prices. Analysts are doubtful.
item.description: In rolling back fuel efficiency standards, the administration said the average new vehicle price in 2031 should be reduced by $1,300.

item.title: Education Department officially scraps Biden-era Title IX rules
item.description: The new regulations mark a return to rules from the first Trump administration.

item.title: Want advice on financing college? Sign up for the Paying for College 101 Newsletter.
item.description: In this six-part guide, reporter Danielle Douglas-Gabriel helps you navigate the complex maze of paying for higher education.

item.title: At every turn, Trump’s ideas for aiding U.S. consumers run into resistance
item.description: From beef to diesel, White House efforts to bring down prices — the top concern among midterm voters — have failed so far to pan out.

item.title: After wildfires devastated Spokane, a high school became an oasis of normalcy
item.description: School-day routines — and even a loss on the football field — have provided relief for students and residents who lost everything.

item.title: DOJ probe into Trump foes sees another prominent departure
item.description: Kurt Olsen, who previously worked as Trump’s election security czar, resigned from the so-called “grand conspiracy” investigation Monday.
